cnnPinn.name: CNN-PINN wind-power model
cnnPinn.architecture: Conv1d(5→32,k3)·GELU·Conv1d(32→32,k3)·GELU·Linear(192→64)·GELU·Linear(64→1), bounded output; input = last 6 ten-minute records
physics: Upper bound: P ≤ min(½·ρ·A·v³·16/27, rated), ρ from outdoor temperature at standard pressure (ideal gas), A from D = 82 m
Monotonicity: ∂P/∂v ≥ 0 for 3–11 m/s (autograd on the input wind speed)
Residuals evaluated on training data and on synthetic steady-wind collocation windows spanning 0–25 m/s

interval.method: Split-conformal residual quantiles per 1 m/s bin (calibrated on Sep 2017)
Split-conformal residual quantiles per 1 m/s bin (calibrated on Sep 2017)

physicsGnn.name: Dynamic Physics-GNN turbine interaction
physicsGnn.graph: 4 turbine nodes; edge weights a_ij(θ) learned from farm wind direction (no coordinates available)
physics: Per-node Betz/rated upper bound with temperature-derived density

split.note: Only timestamps where all four turbines have valid data

forecaster.name: Gradient-boosted farm-power forecaster
forecaster.method: HistGradientBoostingRegressor per horizon; 5 %/95 % quantile models conformalized on the Sep 2017 validation month (CQR) for a 90 % interval
forecaster.target: 4-turbine farm hourly mean power (kW) at t + h; hours with any turbine missing excluded

isolationForest.name: Isolation Forest anomaly detector
isolationForest.method: IsolationForest(300 trees, 4096 samples/tree) fitted on records before 2017-10-01; flag = score above the training 99th percentile; events = ≥3 consecutive flags
